content.text: The real MNIST test set confirms the model was trained with inputs scaled to `[0,1]` and normalized using mean `0.1307`, std `0.3081` (83.3% accuracy), so I’ll use that exact preprocessing. Next I’ll build the native CLI with the bundled `lodepng` decoder and `cJSON` parser.
